faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our academy.

items.question: From what age can I enrol my child?
items.answer: We accept students from 6 to 18 years old, organised by age group and development level, with support suited to each stage.

items.question: Is prior football experience required?
items.answer: No. No prior experience is needed. We work with both beginners and young goalkeepers who already play at clubs and want to improve their technique and performance.

items.question: What should my child bring to training?
items.answer:
Students should bring:
• Comfortable sportswear
• Samuel Soares Goalkeeper School jersey
• Goalkeeper gloves
• Boots suitable for the surface
• Water bottle

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Payment is monthly, with amounts adjusted to weekly attendance. Full details are provided at registration.

items.question: Are sessions cancelled when it rains?
items.answer: As a rule, sessions are not cancelled due to rain. Only in extreme weather or when the pitch is unsafe may a session be postponed or rescheduled.
